create_launcher_bind_experiment: create a Launcher and use bind to set default hyperparameters for scheduling new experiments
schedule_experiment_with_launcher: schedule a new experiment by calling the Launcher with keyword arguments like epochs and batch size
launch_job_array_context: launch multiple experiments as a single Slurm job array using the job_array context manager
customize_slurm_config: customize Slurm parameters like cpus_per_task by calling slurm on a Launcher before scheduling experiments
process_experiment_history: process experiment history data into a metrics dict using the Explorer process_history method
